title: Smoke Signals
description: Sketches Morph Oddly, Kindling Excitement: write something, draw it, guess it, and pass it on. See how far each idea drifts by the end.

settings.label: Time for each turn
settings.help: Hosts can choose another speed for their own game.

choices.label: Quick: 60 seconds to draw, 30 to guess
Normal: 90 seconds to draw, 45 to guess
Relaxed: 2 minutes to draw, 60 seconds to guess
No timer: the host decides when to stop waiting

settings.label: Rounds (a drawing and a guess) in each chain, at least
settings.help: Bigger groups get more rounds, so every chain goes all the way round. Hosts can change this for their own game.

choices.label: Players write their own, or pick an idea
Players pick from the game's ideas only
Coaches only (learners join with a code)
